lines.en: label library15:
scene insertredux1
I have once again returned to the library to be fawned upon by a busty librarian- a thing that most people in life will, unfortunately, never get to experience.
lines.zh: 我又一次回到了图书馆，来接受一位丰满图书管理员的殷勤款待——很遗憾，这世上大多数人这辈子都没机会体验这种事。

lines.en: Our last meeting here was a bit...unusual, so I’m hoping today is at least slightly more grounded in reality and doesn't involve any more strange notebooks.
lines.zh: 上次在这里的见面有点……不同寻常，所以我希望今天至少能稍微接地气一些，不要再冒出什么奇怪的笔记本。

lines.en: Just...what was that thing we read?
lines.zh: 说起来……我们读的那到底是个什么玩意儿？

lines.en: I can’t remember much of it on account of how quick I was to just toss it aside, but what I do remember is-
lines.zh: 当时我把它扔到一边扔得太快，所以记不太清了，不过我还记得的是——

lines.en: scene insertredux2
scene insertredux3
scene insertredux2
scene insertredux3
scene insertredux1
I can't remember anything about it.
lines.zh: 我一点都想不起来了。

lines.en: Time for girl.
lines.zh: 是时候见女孩了。

lines.en: : Good morning, Sensei. You’re here a little early today.
lines.zh: : 早上好，老师。你今天来得有点早呢。

lines.en: : I don't think that's true. I left around the same time as always and checked my phone right before coming in here.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不是吧。我跟平时差不多时间出的门，进门前还看了眼手机。

lines.en: scene insertredux4
: Wait...really? But there’s no one else here yet and you're never the first person in the library after me.
lines.zh: : 等等……真的吗？可现在这里还没有别人，而在我之后，你从来都不是第一个进图书馆的人。

lines.en: : And I know that for a fact because I always judge the time based on how many people show up before you.
lines.zh: : 这一点我敢肯定，因为我一向是靠「在你之前来了多少人」来判断时间的。

lines.en: : What happens if I don’t show up?
lines.zh: : 那要是我没来呢？

lines.en: scene insertredux5
: Hmm...I guess-
scene tree3
TIME STANDS STILL
lines.zh: 时间静止

lines.en: scene insertredux1
: Did you bring your story?
lines.zh: : 你的故事带来了吗？

lines.en: scene insertredux6
: Oh! Yes! And I even made sure it was the right one just a few minutes ago, so we don't have to worry about any other...strange stories appearing in its place.
lines.zh: : 哦！带来了！就在几分钟前我还确认过有没有拿对，所以不用担心会有什么别的……奇怪的故事冒出来顶替它。

lines.en: : I still have to make a few minor changes here and there...but I think it should be at least partially readable by now.
lines.zh: : 我还有一些小地方要改……不过我觉得现在至少已经能读出一部分了。

lines.en: : That's great news. I tend to find that most of the best literary works out there are at least partially readable.
lines.zh: : 这可是好消息。我发现市面上大多数最优秀的文学作品，至少也都「能读出一部分」。

lines.en: scene insertredux7
: Well, I'm certain this is nowhere near the best, but...I tried my hardest.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我敢肯定这远远算不上优秀，不过……我已经尽力了。

lines.en: : So, give me the run-down of your story. Did you try drawing upon any of those daydreams of yours like we talked about?
lines.zh: : 那么，给我大概讲讲你的故事吧。你有没有试着像我们说过的那样，从你那些白日梦里取材？

lines.en: : Well...kind of. But I can't really draw upon the ones that have already happened since I've always just...forgotten them once they end.
lines.zh: : 嗯……算是吧。不过已经发生过的那些我没法真的拿来用，因为我一向在它们结束后就……忘掉了。

lines.en: : I’ve started keeping track of some of the newer ones, though...so the story you’ll read today is about one of those. And-
lines.zh: : 不过我开始把一些比较新的记录下来了……所以你今天要读的故事，就取材于其中一个。而且——

lines.en: Futaba pauses for a moment as she glances over at what I'm assuming is her bag.
lines.zh: Futaba 停顿了一下，瞥了一眼我猜是她书包的东西。

lines.en: scene insertredux8
: I'm sorry...I’m just suddenly feeling really nervous all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 对不起……我只是突然、一下子觉得好紧张……

lines.en: : There's no need to be nervous. This is no different than handing over an assignment in class...Probably.
lines.zh: : 没必要紧张。这跟在课堂上交作业没什么两样……大概吧。

lines.en: : I haven't really accepted any assignments {i}lately,{/i} but I imagine this is kind of like that.
lines.zh: : 我{i}最近{/i}确实没怎么收过作业，但我想大概就是那种感觉。

lines.en: : All things considered, I'm happy with it just being partially readable. The fact that you're comfortable with it is more than enough for me.
lines.zh: : 总而言之，它能「至少读得下去」我就很高兴了。你自己觉得没问题，对我来说就已经足够了。

lines.en: : Well...okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧。

lines.en: : But just...try not to hate it, please...
lines.zh: : 不过……请尽量不要讨厌它……

lines.en: scene black
Futaba timidly pulls a notebook from her bag and hands it over to me with trembling fingers.
lines.zh: Futaba 怯生生地从书包里抽出笔记本，用微微发抖的手指递给我。

lines.en: I lean my back against the window and begin to read what seems like a fairly typical story.
lines.zh: 我背靠着窗户，开始读这个看起来相当普通的故事。

lines.en: A girl sits at home alone in a room full of stuffed animals, wondering what it is about life that leaves her so unfulfilled.
lines.zh: 一个女孩独自待在家里，房间里塞满了毛绒玩具，她不明白生活里到底是什么让她如此空虚。

lines.en: She doesn’t have many friends- just one. A cat named Pedro who walks with a limp.
lines.zh: 她没有多少朋友——只有一个。一只走起路来一瘸一拐的猫，名叫 Pedro。

lines.en: It’s a minor detail, but it’s little things like this that make the world more believable.
lines.zh: 这是个很小的细节，但正是这种小地方让这个世界更加可信。

lines.en: scene story1
I can tell that Futaba is nervous simply by the way she’s standing next to me.
lines.zh: 光看 Futaba 站在我旁边的样子，我就知道她很紧张。

lines.en: Every once in a while, she lets out a deep breath, as if she’s counting down from ten in order to calm her nerves.
lines.zh: 她时不时地深深呼出一口气，像是在从十倒数，好让自己平静下来。

lines.en: Whatever it is, it doesn't seem to be working as she's done it continuously throughout my entire reading session thus far.
lines.zh: 不管那是什么办法，看起来都不太管用——到目前为止我读的整个过程中，她一直在这么做。

lines.en: I continue reading Futaba’s story and, as expected, it goes exactly where I imagined it would.
lines.zh: 我继续读着 Futaba 的故事，不出所料，情节完全朝我预想的方向发展。

lines.en: Eventually, the girl meets a boy who doesn’t see her the way everyone else does.
lines.zh: 最终，女孩遇见了一个不以旁人眼光看待她的男孩。

lines.en: He’s not popular or an athlete or anything like that- just an average guy with no discernible traits or characteristics.
lines.zh: 他既不受欢迎，也不是什么运动健将——只是个看不出任何特点的普通男生。

lines.en: Things progress and the two of them start dating.
lines.zh: 事情一步步发展，两人开始交往。

lines.en: It’s a story that appears to be about overcoming self-perception or...allowing yourself to lean on others when that doesn't seem possible.
lines.zh: 这看起来是一个关于克服自我认知的故事，或者说……关于在本以为不可能的时候，允许自己依靠他人。

lines.en: It’s clearly parallel to how I imagine Futaba feels in real life.
lines.zh: 这显然和我猜想中 Futaba 在现实里的感受是对应的。

lines.en: I do have one question, though...
lines.zh: 不过我有一个问题……

lines.en: scene story2
: Why did you kill Pedro?
lines.zh: : 你为什么把 Pedro 写死了？

lines.en: scene story3
: Was that part...bad?
lines.zh: : 那一段……很糟糕吗？

lines.en: : It wasn’t {i}bad.{/i} It just felt...uncalled for? It didn’t really add anything to the story and felt like it was just...more of a shock value thing.
lines.zh: : 倒不{i}糟糕{/i}。只是觉得……有点没必要？它对故事没什么实质贡献，感觉更像是……单纯为了制造冲击。

lines.en: scene story4
: It was...supposed to symbolize hardship since...he was her only friend at first.
lines.zh: : 那是……想用来象征苦难，因为……他一开始是她唯一的朋友。

lines.en: : There were symbols of hardship all over the place and the cat was essentially abandoned as a character as soon as the guy came along.
lines.zh: : 苦难的象征到处都是，而且那个男生一出现，这只猫基本上就被当作角色抛弃了。

lines.en: : So...I’m...a failure then?
lines.zh: : 所以……我……是个失败者吗？

lines.en: : You're not a failure. It was actually a pretty solid story apart from that.
lines.zh: : 你不是失败者。除开那一点，这其实是个相当扎实的故事。

lines.en: : Maybe a little basic, but a great first attempt. I’m impressed.
lines.zh: : 也许稍微有点老套，但作为第一次尝试已经很棒了。我很佩服。

lines.en: scene story5
: Wait...You mean that? You liked it?
lines.zh: : 等等……你是认真的？你喜欢它？

lines.en: : Sure. Great job, Futaba. Another A+ in the grade book that I totally keep and am not making up.
lines.zh: : 当然。干得好，Futaba。成绩册上又一个 A+——我绝对有在记，绝对不是现编的。

lines.en: scene story6
: Then...umm...What did you think about the main character?...
lines.zh: : 那么……呃……你觉得主角怎么样？……

lines.en: : Was she...likeable?
lines.zh: : 她……讨人喜欢吗？

lines.en: : Is that...the kind of person you'd want to spend time with in real life?
lines.zh: : 她是那种……你在现实里愿意与之相处的人吗？

lines.en: Ahh, there we go. Futaba wants me to grade her self-insert character that ends up alongside the insert-version of me.
lines.zh: 啊，来了来了。Futaba 是想让我给她那个自我代入的角色打个分——那个最后和「代入版」的我走到一起的角色。

lines.en: The honest answer would be that the girl in her notebook is just as unremarkable as the man she ultimately falls for.
lines.zh: 老实说，她笔记本里的那个女孩，和她最终爱上的那个男人一样平凡无奇。

lines.en: But I’ll let that slide for today since the one in real life is better and...significantly more tangible.
lines.zh: 不过今天我就不戳破了，毕竟现实里的那个更好，而且……摸得着得多。

lines.en: : I think she was really interesting, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她很有意思，Futaba。

lines.en: scene story7
: Really?! You think so?!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？！你真这么觉得？！

lines.en: : I do. It's unfortunate the story ended where it did.
lines.zh: : 是的。可惜故事就停在了那个地方。

lines.en: : I'd really like to learn a little more about her.
lines.zh: : 我真的很想多了解她一点。

lines.en: scene story8
: You'd like to...learn more about her, huh?...
lines.zh: : 你想……多了解她一点，是吗？……

lines.en: : If only...we knew who the writer was...Hahaha...Hah...
lines.zh: : 要是……我们知道作者是谁就好了……哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : Right. {i}If only.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊。{i}要是知道就好了{/i}。

lines.en: scene story9
: Umm...Sensei?...
: I just want to say thank you for always being around and...giving me positive encouragement and all that.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说声谢谢，谢谢你一直陪在我身边，还有……一直给我正面的鼓励什么的。

lines.en: : I was really nervous about today and...you made me feel really calm...
lines.zh: : 我今天本来特别紧张，可……你让我觉得很安心……

lines.en: : So, umm...I wouldn't mind telling you a little more some time...
lines.zh: : 所以，呃……改天我不介意再多跟你讲一点……

lines.en: scene story10
: About the character, I mean...
lines.zh: : 我是说，关于那个角色……

lines.en: : Oh yeah? I think I might have to take you up on that. I’ve been meaning to stop by your dorm again anyway.
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？那我可得接下这个话头了。反正我也一直想着再去你宿舍一趟。

lines.en: : Well...You know which room I’m in, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你知道我住哪间房，所以……

lines.en: : I'll be there...whenever you want...
lines.zh: : 我会在那里的……随时都行……

lines.en: scene black
The two of us chat for a few more minutes before it comes time for me to head out.
lines.zh: 我们又聊了几分钟，然后就到了我该走的时候。

lines.en: Her story was a lot longer than I expected a first-try to be...but I’m honestly really impressed, all flaws aside.
lines.zh: 作为第一次尝试，她的故事比我预想的长得多……但抛开所有瑕疵不谈，我是真的挺佩服的。

lines.en: For someone who doesn’t normally write, she definitely has potential.
lines.zh: 对于一个平时不怎么写东西的人来说，她确实很有潜力。

lines.en: I’m sure all the reading she does helps, but that sort of thing can only carry you so far.
lines.zh: 她读那么多书肯定有帮助，不过那种东西能起到的作用也就到此为止了。

lines.en: Eventually, we part ways- but not before making plans with Futaba to meet up again soon.
lines.zh: 最后我们分开了——不过在那之前，我和 Futaba 约好了近期再见面。
